item.title: Miners discover rare 11,000-carat ruby weighing nearly five pounds
item.description: Miners in Myanmar discovered an 11,000-carat ruby weighing nearly five pounds. Miners in Myanmar have unearthed an 11,000-carat ruby thought to be the second heaviest ever found in the war-torn country.

item.title: Israeli drone strikes near Beirut kill four; southern airstrikes claim at least 13 lives
item.description: Israeli drone strikes near Beirut killed four people and southern airstrikes killed at least 13. The Israeli military said Hezbollah fired explosive drones into Israel near the border with Lebanon adding that three soldiers were wounded, one of them seriously, in one of the attacks.

item.title: Plane hits and kills pedestrian during takeoff at Denver airport
item.description: Denver International Airport reported a plane struck and killed a pedestrian during takeoff at 11:19 p. m. on May 9. The incident involved Frontier Flight 4345, according to the airport's statement.

item.title: Magyar sworn in as Hungary’s prime minister on promises of change
item.description: Peter Magyar was sworn in as Hungary's prime minister, promising change. He faces a tight deadline to secure billions of euros in suspended European Union funding to boost the economy and stabilize public finances.

item.title: Army is fighting 'aggressive' NATO-backed force: Putin in Victory Day speech
item.description: Russian President Putin said the army is fighting an "aggressive" NATO-backed force in a Victory Day speech. The parade was scaled back, with no military hardware on display and limited foreign dignitaries in attendance.

item.title: U.K. PM Starmer turns to Labour Party grandees after tough local election verdict
item.description: UK PM Starmer appoints Labour Party grandees, including former PM Gordon Brown, to boost security and resilience. On the appointment of the two Labour Party grandees, Mr. Starmer said that as Britain’s longest-serving chancellor, former PM Gordon Brown is well placed to work with international allies to boost the country’s security and resilience.

item.title: Frontier plane kills pedestrian during takeoff, passengers evacuated after engine fire
item.description: A Frontier plane struck and killed a pedestrian during takeoff at Denver International Airport, then experienced an engine fire. Passengers were evacuated from the plane, according to reports. Frontier plane kills pedestrian during takeoff, passengers evacuated after engine fire.

item.title: Peter Magyar Takes Over as Hungary’s Leader From Viktor Orban
item.description: Peter Magyar succeeded Viktor Orban as Hungary's leader, winning a landslide election. He now faces the challenge of dismantling Orban's "illiberal democracy" and addressing the country's economic and financial issues.
